owner_confirmation_required: Confirm whether a legal operator name and mailing address must be published for the markets served.
Confirm whether to add a governing-law, venue, arbitration, or class-action term.
Confirm any refund policy beyond rights required by applicable law or written checkout terms.
Confirm Google Analytics property settings and whether regional consent controls are required before analytics loads.
Confirm an operational suppression process for optional checkout-reminder and reactivation email opt-out requests.
Confirm that market-data provider licenses permit the subscriber displays and exports offered by the Service and whether provider attribution is required.
Approve a written operational retention schedule consistent with the criteria stated in the Privacy Policy.
